text: The United States Air Force in the early 50s, Mr. Smith, had a three, I think, top secret
project going for identification of unidentified flying objects, and then they were dropped,
Do you know why, or have you any theories to this?
I couldn't really say why they were dropped unless it was due to the tremendous amount
of publicity and a fair amount of ridicule which was aimed at the whole subject of flying
I do believe, though, that there is some continuing investigation in the United States.
